Standard: The maximum resultant accelerations measured at the chest during bailout parachute opening do not exceed 15g (resultant vector sum). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(1) Flight test: Chest accelerations are verified through full system-level dynamic test with full-body manikins representing the intended anthropometric population across the bailout envelope.
(2) Flight test: Chest accelerations are verified through full system-level dynamic test with human subjects representing the intended anthropometric population across the bailout envelope.
